opening.argument: The presentation chiefly explains USDCx on Cardano: its stated backing by USDC, how deposits and attestations support one-to-one minting, and potential uses reflected in early market data. It also draws a clear limit on that data, calling it evidence of potential rather than proof of success and expressly saying adoption is not guaranteed. The separate exchange referral offers are disclosed as paid affiliate links; the supplied evidence does not establish a connection between those offers and the USDCx discussion. In this informational crypto-media context, those disclosed affiliations do not establish deceptive conduct.
